title: Robinsons Malls cuts grid power use by 5.8M kWh in Q2

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Robinsons Malls reduced its reliance on grid electricity through energy efficiency and conservation efforts, avoiding about 5.8 million kilowatt-hours in grid power imports from April to June 2026. The commercial centers division of Robinsons Land Corp. (RLC) said the volume was equivalent to the average monthly electricity consumption of around 29,000 Filipino households. READ: DOE chief urges consumers to adopt energy conservation lifestyle Additionally, the initiatives earned Robinsons Malls recognition as an Energy Efficiency and Conservation Champion at the inaugural Philippine Energy Awards on Oct. 7.
